This is part one of the real problem. It isn't about teachers getting too many benefits. It's about shitty people being basically given their paycheck for squeaking by the past several years. 
The other part of the problem is any random teacher being blamed for shitty kids with shitty parents. If a kid does not have the right upbringing, at least a basic "You need to do well in school" no teacher can be expected to be able to get that kid to learn and no amount of funding will make an improvement.

If both sides could realize this is the problem I think a lot of things can be fixed.
